title: Captain Jack and Emerald Cove
moral: Teamwork and friendship are more valuable than treasure.

scenes.summary: Captain Jack finds a mysterious map to Emerald Cove.
scenes.text: Captain Jack sailed the sea on his ship, the Sea Serpent. One day, a mysterious map appeared, showing a hidden treasure at Emerald Cove. He gathered his crew and prepared for the journey.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate captain holding treasure map on ship with crew excited cartoon children’s book style

scenes.summary: A rival pirate ship attacks during the journey.
scenes.text: On their way, they encountered Captain Blackbeard and his ship, the Black Pearl. A fierce battle began as both crews fought for the treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: two pirate ships fighting with cannons and swords cartoon style

scenes.summary: The crew reaches Emerald Cove and explores the island.
scenes.text: After winning the battle, they reached Emerald Cove. The island was full of jungles, caves, and obstacles, but the crew worked together to move forward.
scenes.image_prompt: pirates exploring jungle island with cliffs and caves cartoon style

scenes.summary: They solve riddles and find the treasure but face Blackbeard again.
scenes.text: Inside a hidden cave behind a waterfall, they solved riddles to unlock a treasure. But Blackbeard returned, leading to a final battle.
scenes.image_prompt: pirates solving cave puzzle with glowing treasure and enemy pirate appearing cartoon style

scenes.summary: Captain Jack realizes the true treasure is friendship.
scenes.text: After the battle, Captain Jack and his crew realized that friendship and teamwork mattered more than gold. They sailed away happily.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate crew sailing into sunset smiling after adventure cartoon style

story: Once upon a time, Captain Jack sailed the sea on his ship, the Sea Serpent. One day, he found a mysterious map leading to Emerald Cove. With his crew, he set out to find the treasure. Along the way, they fought a rival pirate, Captain Blackbeard, and won. Reaching the island, they faced many challenges but worked together to overcome them. Inside a hidden cave, they found a great treasure but had to fight Blackbeard again. In the end, they realized that teamwork and friendship were more valuable than gold and sailed home happily.
